en: The Apadāna of the Elder Kakkārupupphiya Mandāravapupphiya Chapter 2, Number 2 I offered a kakkāru flower to the Buddha, the One with Vision, the Teacher who was free from all defilements. By that root of merit, I have attained the state of an Arhat. Having abandoned birth and death, I have transcended the realm of Māra. With the exhaustion of all taints, I have realized parinibbāna. This is my final birth; there shall be no further existence. Thus did the Elder Kakkārupupphiya speak.
[approached] Gotama, who bears the śrīvatsa mark,
I offered it to the Buddha.
I do not know a state of misery;
this is the fruit of worshipping the Buddha.
the Buddha’s teaching has been accomplished.
Thus indeed did the Venerable Elder Kakkārupupphiya speak these verses.
The legend of the Elder Kakkārupupphiya is the second.
